name: com.gamecore.gameplay.audio
description: Catalog row 11 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.5): audio and atmosphere. Kernel half: the audio plugin (owner gameplay.audio.owner) with the audio.musicState, audio.ambienceZone and audio.volumeMaster/Music/Sfx/Voice slots on a per-world audio session target, the audio.setMusicState, audio.setAmbienceZone, audio.setVolume, audio.playSfx, audio.playVoice and audio.stopVoice routes and their events (MusicStateChanged, AmbienceChanged, VolumeChanged, SfxPlayed, VoicePlayed, VoiceStopped), mounted through the world extension seam; the rules live in com.gamecore.rules.gameplay (Runtime/Audio). Runtime: AudioRuntime (follows committed slots and events, directs ambience from RegionEntered, registers IVoiceLinePlayer, IFeedbackSink and IVolumeSettingsSink), MusicController (states, stingers, equal-power crossfades), AmbienceZoneBinder, SfxPool, VoicePlayer, AudioMixerBinding (exposed volume parameters), AudioEngineHost (AudioSources only when a graphics device exists), AnimationEventRelay (footsteps to IFeedbackSink) and the authorable AudioBankDefinition, MusicStateDefinition, AmbienceDefinition and AudioSetDefinition. Editor: audio.assignClip, audio.setAmbience, audio.setMusicState, audio.generateVoice and audio.generateSfx (through IMediaGenerationGateway; NotConfigured until the Studio ETOS client supplies one), the audio validator and the deterministic procedural placeholder generator (.wav plus .manifest.json).
